attribution.why: The advertiser's next version says “三档色温 无可视频闪” (three colour temperatures, no visible flicker), an ordinary product specification. The agent rejects it: once as unverifiable under the false-advertising article CN-AL-28, once as an absolute term because of “无”. The guidance clauses on when absolute wording is allowed were available and not consulted for this phrase.
attribution.fix: Tell the agent that a factual specification is not a violation unless a clause says so, and that CN-AL-28 needs evidence that the claim is false, not only that the ad shows no proof; add a regression item with ordinary specifications.

The extra cause is a refund rise in 美发美甲, a slice the monitor itself flags (refund rate, robust z 9.7); the agent traces it to one chain whose refunds roughly tripled. attribution.fix: Re-draw cases whose world raises an unplanted alert on a primary metric, or score a cause on a monitor-flagged slice with a concentrated movement as acceptable.
